d: Curly, shoulder-length honey-blonde hair is styled with a large teal bow on top and small teal ribbons throughout. The eyes are a glowing pale mint green with a wide, innocent expression on a youthful, childlike face. A petite build is dressed in a high-waisted, cream-colored gown featuring oversized puffed sleeves with ruffled cuffs and a brown leather harness with buckles across the chest and shoulders. Signature details include a long, flowing teal ribbon draped from the chest and grey buckled straps wrapping around the ankles.
